title: fix(objectql)!: an option field stores the option code string a number or boolean was judged by, and refuses any object (#29562)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9VCmqM8tUaCACEK5ub61zmo)_

Fixes #29562

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none. No file under `skills/**` or `content/docs/**` teaches writing a number, a boolean or a non-plain object into an option field; a `git grep` of both trees for option fields shows option codes written as strings only.

Measured on `origin/main` @ `d3175d59` (base) and on this branch (head), the engine and REST doors, SQLite and driver-memory (table under Acceptance notes): a `unique` option field now refuses `3` after `"3"` (and `true` after `"true"`), and a `Date`, `Map`, `Set` or class instance on an option field is now refused. Those are the narrowing. On SQLite, `true` after `1` on a unique option field used to be refused (both stored `"1.0"`) and now lands: the widening half. The metadata protocol is untouched (`none`): no key, value or metadata type an author writes moves.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:选项类字段(单选 select / radio,多选 multiselect / checkboxes / tags,及 `multiple: true` 的 select / radio)收到数字或布尔值时,改为存储校验器判定时用的字符串(`3` 存为 `"3"`,`true` 存为 `"true"`,多选逐个元素同理);`Date`、`Map`、类实例等非普通对象一律以 `invalid_type` 拒绝。
- **为什么改**:规范规定选项字段的值是字符串选项码,但写入时把原始数字直接交给驱动:内存驱动存成数字 `3`,SQLite 存成 `"3.0"`,与存 `"3"` 的行分裂成两个值,筛选、分组、唯一约束因驱动而异。这是 #29241 文本类字段修复的选项类孪生。
- **风险与回滚**:同一次写入的接受/拒绝结果不变;变化在于唯一选项字段上 `3` 与 `"3"` 现在冲突(409),非普通对象被拒,以及用数字 `3` 作筛选值不再命中新写入的行(筛选侧由 #29486 决定,本 PR 不动)。旧行不改写。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:① `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts` 的 `normalizeNumericStringRow`(选项分支)与 `isObjectValue`;② 单选分支与多选元素分支的形状判定;③ `packages/rest/src/rest-data-option-scalar-value.test.ts`(真实 SQLite)。
- **两分钟验证**:在已构建的工作区跑 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/rest-data-option-scalar-value.test.ts`,预期 10/10 通过:`POST { stage: 3 }` 的物理列为 `"3"`,唯一字段先 `3` 后 `"3"` 第二次为 409。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地

## What changes

- **The door writes the judged string** (`normalizeNumericStringRow` in `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts`, the function the #29241 text-family half lives in, reusing its `isStringReadScalar` and `String(value)`). On an option-family field (`SINGLE_OPTION_TYPES` ∪ `MULTI_OPTION_TYPES`, the spec's two sets, read and not re-listed), a number or a boolean is written as `String(value)`. On a multi-value option field, each number or boolean element is written the same way, and a lone scalar is written as its string before the engine wraps it. It runs where the text half runs: insert, insertMany, update by id, update by predicate and the `validate()` dry run, `readonly` values included (their shape is judged on every write). Not touched: strings, `null`, objects (refused), an array on a single-value field (refused), and non-scalar elements.
- **The option arms refuse any object** (`isObjectValue`). The single-value select / radio arm and the multi-value element test used `isPlainObjectValue || Array.isArray`, which is prototype-strict, so a `Date`, `Map`, `Set` or class instance fell through to membership. With no `options` it was stored as sent; with `options` it was refused `invalid_option` by the accident of its string reading. Now each is refused `invalid_type` with the #29244 value-shape sentence ("expected one option value, received an object", or "… an element that is an object"). It is never stringified, per the seat ruling 6587559938. The text arm keeps its own posture; this rule is on option-family fields only.
- **Header realigned** (should-fix S3 of review 6585290571): the "Rules applied" list now follows `validateOne`'s actual order (required, then the operator rule, then the string arm with its #29133 / #29241 shape rules, numbers, boolean, temporal, select, multi-value, value shape) and names the #29244 and #29562 select rules.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/29562-option-field-scalar-stored-string.md`: `@objectstack/objectql` patch, `fix(objectql)!:`, the two declaration lines, ADR-0087 `not-required`, a BREAKING banner with FROM → TO and the caller fix, the `#29241` shape.
- No `packages/spec/**`, no new error code, no filter-door change, no `protocol.ts`.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.option-scalar-value.test.ts` (new): the door on all five option types and on `multiple: true` select / radio, per scalar (`3`, `0`, `-1.5`, `true`, `false`) and per element; membership on the written string (a declared code `"3"` admits `3`, codes a/b still refuse it); readonly fields written too; the untouched cases; the object refusal (Date, Map, Set, class instance) on single-value and element, insert and update, readonly; the engine doors end to end with a recording driver (insert, insertMany, update by id, update by predicate), the non-plain refusal with no driver write, and the unique key seeing one value.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-data-option-scalar-value.test.ts` (new): REST POST / PATCH on a real SQLite `SqlDriver`, physical column read past every engine coercion: single, radio, declared code, multi-value elements and a lone scalar; `invalid_option` still answered with nothing written; the unique narrowing (`3`/`"3"`, `"3"`/`3`, `true`/`"true"` → 409) and SQLite's `true`/`1` widening; and a **filter-face pin that records today's answer only** (`{ stage: 3 }` matches no row once both rows hold `"3"`), naming #29486.
- **Forced test edit (one):** `record-validator.select-shape.test.ts`, the `{ free: 3 }` control in `what the rule leaves alone`. It pinned the number admission as present behaviour and named this card. It is restated as the new rule: still admitted by the validator, and written by the door as `{ free: "3" }`.
- driver-memory: no new test consumer (its test consumers are a closed census, `check:driver-memory-census`). The memory column was measured (table below), and the recording-driver pin shows what every driver receives.

## Acceptance notes

1. **Step 0 table**, base `d3175d59` vs head, each row on engine insert / update by id / update by predicate and REST POST / PATCH, both drivers (1100 cells per side; the two drivers agree on every answer):

| field · value | base memory | base SQLite | head (both) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| free select / radio · `3` / `true` | `3` / `true` | `"3.0"` / `"1.0"` | `"3"` / `"true"` |
| select, codes `"3"`,`"true"` · `3` / `true` | admitted, `3` / `true` | admitted, `"3.0"` / `"1.0"` | admitted, `"3"` / `"true"` |
| select, codes a/b · `3` | `invalid_option` | `invalid_option` | `invalid_option` |
| multi option (5 types) · `[3]` or lone `3` | `[3]` | `[3]` (JSON) | `["3"]` |
| free select / radio · Date / Map / instance (engine) | stored as sent | epoch / `"{}"` / JSON text | `invalid_type` |
| declared select / multiselect · Date / Map / instance | `invalid_option` | `invalid_option` | `invalid_type` |
| free multi option · `[Date]` / `[Map]` / `[instance]` | ISO text / `{}` / JSON | same | `invalid_type` |
| unique select · `3` then `"3"` (and reverse; `true` then `"true"`) | 201, 201 | 201, 201 | 201, 409 |
| unique select · `true` then `1` | 201, 201 | 201, 409 | 201, 201 |

   A non-plain object cannot reach REST (a JSON body carries none); it reaches the engine doors (flows, hooks, server code).
2. **Writer census: 0 product writers.** A log-only probe at the door (every option-family field receiving a number, a boolean, a non-plain object, or an array holding one) in a second worktree at base `d3175d59`, objectql rebuilt there, then each suite with the probe's env set: objectql (all), rest (all), service-automation (all), every package under `packages/plugins/**`, runtime (local tier) and the full dogfood battery (397 files, 3277 tests). Hits: 0 in every leg. Positive controls hit: the Step 0 probe script against that tree's `dist` (658 lines) and a throwaway vitest file against its `src` (1 line). So no product writer and no existing test sends a number or boolean to an option field through the engine, and the seat's ruling A needs no re-rule.
3. **Filter face, measured and not changed** (#29486's decision box). A row written `9` and a row written `"9"`: base `{ free: 9 }` answered the `9` row only, and `{ free: "9" }` the `"9"` row only; head `{ free: 9 }` answers no row and `{ free: "9" }` both, on both drivers. Named in open_questions.
4. **Stored rows** are not rewritten: an old raw `3` (driver-memory with persistence) or SQLite `"3.0"` keeps reading as it is and does not collide with a new `"3"`. Whether `os migrate value-shapes` should carry option fields is an open question, not built.
5. **Out of scope, noted:** the text arm still admits a non-plain object (a `Date` on a `text` field passes as its string reading and is stored as sent); this card's ruling is option-family only. carrier: none.

## Verification

Head `6f164722`: the fix commits `271c2665` (code) and `ca133d57` (tests, changeset) plus a merge of `origin/main` @ `0ab4a09e` (no conflict; main's objectql moves are in `engine.ts` / `engine-reference-name-visible.ts`, none in `record-validator.ts`).
